props.name: src
props.description: An equirectangular image: 360° across, 180° top to bottom, twice as wide as tall.

props.name: alt
props.description: What the scene is. Names the viewer and the flat fallback image.

props.name: initialYaw
props.description: Starting heading in degrees. 0 is the centre of the image; 90 is a quarter to the right.

props.name: initialPitch
props.description: Starting tilt in degrees, positive looking up.

props.name: initialFov
props.description: Starting field of view in degrees. Smaller is more zoomed in.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Turn slowly on its own. `true` is 6°/s; a number is degrees per second. Never under reduced motion.
